Full Stack Developer Co-op (TypeScript)
Join our product team building tools used by thousands of students.

You will
* Build features end to end with Next.js, React and TypeScript
* Design REST APIs with Node.js/Express and PostgreSQL (Prisma)
* Implement authentication (OAuth, SSO) and role-based access
* Write Playwright end-to-end tests and deploy on Vercel

What we're looking for
* Strong TypeScript and React skills
* Experience with SQL databases
* You have shipped at least one full-stack project

Nice to haves: Tailwind CSS, Supabase, GCP, web scraping experience
